interval: Pointwise descriptive 95 percent t interval over the 64 independent whole blocks; no multiplicity-adjusted or confirmatory claim
primary: Correct chooser P4 versus correct-model P1 after two probes; descriptive replication only
reference: Always correct-model fixed-order P1 at the same probe count; every scoring posterior retains full true-mechanism support
stopping: Fixed 64 complete verified blocks; only resource/failure/deadline stops; no outcome-dependent expansion or descendants
validation: Pre-data known-answer controls, excluded full-block original/replay/independent reconstruction, complete replay and independent reconstruction for every scientific block
weighting: Within each case average omitted-other chooser scenarios; then equal cases, variants, laws and source families; uncertainty unit is whole balanced block
